Type 2 diabetes in adults: management

This guideline covers the care and management of type 2 diabetes in adults.

Recommendations

Offer lifestyle advice at diagnosis and reinforce it at every review.

Drug treatment

Offer standard-release metformin as first-line drug treatment.

DrugStarting dose
Metformin500 mg twice daily
